status: Design policy; full source installation pending review

native_only_alternates.Form: Literal NFC Bengali source spelling; explicit exception to phonetic display transcription.
native_only_alternates.Phonemic: Blank when source supplies no independently aligned IPA; never inherit the primary head pronunciation.
native_only_alternates.identity: Stable child keys tied to source position and explicit Variant_Of_Key relation.
native_only_alternates.audit: Typed missing-source-IPA reason; keep source witness and exact printed/API evidence.
native_only_alternates.profile: Literal Bengali preservation route with corpus-wide symbol coverage; must not turn source-script Form into purported IPA.

primary_IPA: Publisher API IPA remains its own source layer. Native-print dental/retroflex or other differences must not be silently substituted.
partial_IPA: If IPA covers only a component of a longer native head, preserve component analysis in audit rather than assign it as full-form Phonemic.
english_print_IPA: IPA in English-headed edition describes English control headings, not Koda; never use as Koda pronunciation.
editions: Cite each edition separately when using its attestation; pairing is contextual evidence, not proof of identical wording.
